name: Slice-guided Semiautomatic Multivariate Volume Exploration
definition: A slice-guided semiautomatic multivariate volume exploration workflow that replaces trial-and-error parameter space views with a guided uncertainty-aware lasso and automated feature extraction, allowing users to select features on 2D slices and automatically generate multivariate transfer functions.
summary: GuideME is an interactive volume visualization workflow that replaces trial-and-error transfer function tuning with a guided, uncertainty-aware region selection process on 2D slices.
